Translation: O Allah, expand my chest through the Quran
And employ my body through the Quran
And illuminate my sight through the Quran
And loosen my tongue through the Quran
And help me with it as long as You keep me alive

Arabic text: فَإِنَّهُ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِكَ
Translation: For verily there is no might nor power except through You
